stressCase: The same explicit content-addressed audio target must survive Android APK packaging, synthetic-origin WebView loading and CDP execution while preserving VSR asset-residency and receipt-root continuity.
donorAdvantage: Reality Build already supplies the Android embedded HTML host, synthetic origin and CDP evidence seam; VSR supplies generic SHA-verified asset residency, so no native Android audio registry or parallel asset loader was added.
regressionCase: The Android plan remains explicit and bound, unbound cues remain blocked, the embedded asset is loaded once into VSR ready state, decode pending resolves to scheduled, and the scheduled receipt retains the same VSR receipt root.
boundaries: This is an API 35 Android ATD Emulator/WebView target execution candidate, not physical-device or production-device acceptance.
The APK is debug-signed, not a release-signed APK/AAB or store-delivery artifact.
A scheduled Web Audio buffer receipt proves target execution and decode scheduling only; it does not prove audible output, native speaker routing, latency, mixing quality or human listening.
The WebGPU warnings keep native GPU and performance claims closed; no native GPU or audio equivalence is inferred.
No target-side voice cap, mixer/bus policy, continuous-stream policy, cache budget or latency budget was introduced or verified.
No K400 gate is promoted to PASS.
nextCandidate: Keep the VSR receipt continuity as evidence and audit whether a canonical owner exists for target-side cache budget or continuous/segmented audio streaming; physical-device listening remains a separate human gate.
